description: This file defines the MessageOnlyLogFilter class, a logger filter for Android applications that filters out all metadata and only outputs the message content. It implements the LogNode interface and is aimed at simplifying log output for readability.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A log filter class that only outputs the message content, omitting additional metadata for clarity.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the log filter with a next LogNode to chain output.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Filters log messages, only passing the message to the next node with minimal metadata.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
